name: 会話で共有する地図の位置
prompt:
Create a second version of the LH03-0156 map attachment, matching the native preview at exactly 390:190. Use the same map content and card treatment, with these geometric corrections at logical 390x190 coordinates:
- Outer pale-mint card: x≈78, y≈8, width≈296, height≈170.
- Inner map crop: x≈85, y≈15, width≈284, height≈155.
- Forest-green time pill: x≈292, y≈139, width≈69, height≈22, with centered white 「21:49」.

The first version was too far left and low, slightly too wide and short, and its timestamp pill was too narrow and low. Align these edges and dimensions to the native preview. Preserve the rounded card corners and white outer canvas margin.

Preserve the original map composition from the Telegram source: the blue pin at the 9TH ST / N ST intersection, pale road lines, green park, small roundabout, nearby light-gray building and lower-left Apple Maps mark. Keep the same crop and orientation; do not invent new roads, labels, pins or landmarks. Use the native map preview for exact layout and the original screenshot for map details.

This component has no hyperlink text. Keep the blue location marker as artwork and do not add blue text or URLs. Do not add chat chrome, message text, controls, other maps, person photos, shadows or texture.
reviewNotes: 第2版を目視。道路ラベル・Apple Maps・青い位置ピン・21:49を保持。v001に比べ横位置とタイムピル位置は改善したが、native 390x190比で外枠は約x82/y27、幅275/高140となり、native x78/y8、幅296/高170に対し上から約19px下、幅約22px不足、高さ約30px不足。時刻ピルは位置が近づいたが幅が約16px不足。v001の方が外枠の高さと下端は近い。2回の限定試行後でneeds-correctionを記録し、これ以上生成せず次IDへ進む。地図細部は元画像と画素一致せず、所有者受入・編集可能性・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
